title: Coexistence in the condensate food chain where both kinds divide needs space: predators and prey coexist to t=12000 on 0/4 seeds at 32^2, 2/4 at 48^2, 3/4 at 64^2, 4/4 at 96^2 and 3/3 at 128^2, as in the spatial Rosenzweig-MacArthur control
summary: The claim world of 20261026T1302-c42-foodchain-both-divide-claim (Du 1, chi 0, k0 0.002, unchanged) run with drive.py (counts every 100 t) on square arenas L = 32, 48, 64, 96, seeds 0-3, t=12000. A run counts as coexisting when predator droplets are present at every count from t=6000 on and prey droplets at >= 50% of them (arena_table.txt). L=32: predators die at t=3700 and 4900 or never form (seeds 0-2); on seed 3 they persist but prey droplets are present only 41% of the late time. L=48: predators die at 4700 and 5400 (seeds 0, 2), coexist on seeds 1 and 3. L=64: 3/4 (seed 1 loses its predators at t=11600). L=96: 4/4 (prey present 85-100% of the late counts). The claim's 128^2 labkit packs (seeds 0-2) and the 256^2 pack (seed 3) end with both kinds present. This is the spatial-rescue pattern of the positive control in 20261026T1200-c42-mixed-diet-predators (spatial Rosenzweig-MacArthur with an extinction floor: L 16-32 extinct, 64-128 persist) and of c26's Lenia predator (20261026T0117-c26-predator-persistence-sizes): small arenas synchronize the predation wave and lose a species; larger ones keep asynchronous patches. Limits: 4 seeds per size, one duration (12000), and the 128^2 entry comes from the claim's packs, not drive.py.

finding.operator: spatial extent (arena size) in the closed condensate food chain
finding.control: arena size 32/48/64/96 (4 seeds each) at fixed parameters, t=12000
finding.result: coexisting seeds: 32^2 0/4, 48^2 2/4, 64^2 3/4, 96^2 4/4 (128^2 3/3 and 256^2 1/1 in the claim's packs); predator last-alive t in failing runs 3700, 4900, never, 4700, 5400, 11600
